plugins.name: n8n-autopilot
plugins.description: Build, validate, and deploy n8n workflows from Claude Code. CLI-first (n8nac reference 2.7.0, minimum 2.3.0; auto-installed via npx) plus a bundled test/read MCP server (n8n-native) against the instance of the pinned env. Requires Node.js 18+ and the companion plugin `n8n-as-code@n8nac-marketplace` (Etienne Lescot) for the `n8n-architect` skill. Ships init-repo, build-workflow pipeline, deploy, pull-schemas (CLI + npm-extraction fallback), sync-credentials with --fix-workflows, inventory, data-tables, session-env isolation, plus PreToolUse gates (Bash + PowerShell: env pin, drift, instance node versions, version-gated params, error-handling lint) and SessionStart hooks for staleness detection with auto-reactions.
